paite: Kinakna toh a-inn dim a nopbawl sang in tanghou gaw a muanna toh om ahoihzaw.
Sikha piltak a hih in tapa zumhuaina omsak tung ah vai ahawm ding, huan unaute lak a goutanna ah tan anei ding hi.
Huansianna bel zaw dangka a ding ahi, huan meipi dangka-eng a ding; himahleh TOUPA'N lungtangte a-endik hi.
Hoih lou hihmi'n gilou mukte alimsak a; huan zuauhat in siatna lei abildoh hi.
Kuapeuh genthei musit in amah Bawlpa asimmoh a; huan kuapeuh tuahsiat ni a kipak gawt louh in a-om kei ding hi.
Tate' tate mi upate lallukhu ahi uh; huan tate thupina apate uh ahi.
Thugen hoih mihai toh akilawm kei; muk zuauthei lal toh akilawm kei sem hi.
Anei mit ah thilpiak suangmantam bang ahi; koilam peuh a akiheina ah, alohching hi.
Kuapeuh tatlekna khuh in itna azong hi; himahleh kuapeuh thubuai a nuamsa in lawmte akhendalh hi.
Mihai sung a vuakna zakhat sang in theihsiamna neimi sung ah taina alut thukzaw.
Mihoih lou in helna kia azong a; huaiziak in sawltak khel amah dou ding a sawl in a-om ding hi.
Vompi anoute laksak a om in mi tuak hen, ahaina a mihai sang in.
Kuapeuh hoih sik a gilou kipahman pia, a-inn a kipan gilou apaimang kei ding.
Kinakna kipatna mi'n tui akhahkhiak bang ahi; huaiziak in kinakna a-om ma in, kiselna paisan in.
Kuapeuh gilou siamtangsak, kuapeuh midiktat mohpaih, amau gel TOUPA a ding in kihhuai ahi tuaktuak uhi.
Huaiziak in pilna lei ding in mihai khut ah aman a-om a hia, theihsiamna anei kei chih thei in?
Lawm in chik lai peuh in a-it gige a, huan vangtah ni a ding in unau khat apiang hi.
Mi theihsiamna bei in khut abeng a, invengte ma ah moh khu ding in ahong om hi.
Kinakna deih in tatlekna adeih hi; kuapeuh akongpi domsang in siatna azong hi.
Kuapeuh lungtang sia nei in hoih amu kei; huan siatna ah lei hoih lou nei apuk hi.
Kuapeuh mihai suang in alungkhamna ding in asuang; huan mihaipa'n nopsakna anei kei hi.
Lungtang nuamsa damdawi hoih ahi; himahleh lungsim puakkham in guhte akeusak.
Migilou in angsung a kipan in thilpiak alakhia a, vaihawmna lampi heikawisak ding in.
Theihsiamna neimi ma ah pilna a-om; himahleh mihai mitte lei tawp ah a-om hi.
Apa a ding in tapa hai lungkhamna ahi a, amah piangsaknu a ding in khatna ahi.
Midiktat gawt hiam thutak ziak a milian zep leng ahoih kei hi.
Kuapeuh theihna neimi akamsim thei hi; kuapeuh theihsiamna nei lungsim tawldam in a-om hi.
Mihai nangawn, adaih dide lai in, pil a ngaih ahi; amukte achih lai in, pilvang bang a theih ahi.
